headline: Laser Power & Infra bags new contracts
hook: New order wins for Laser Power
summary: Laser Power & Infra Limited has informed the stock exchange that it has received new orders or contracts. The specific financial value and details of the counterparties were not disclosed in the filing. Such order wins contribute to the company's execution pipeline. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap infrastructure and power-related stocks should monitor order book growth for revenue visibility.
why_it_matters: Order inflows add to small-cap revenue visibility.
